notes.title: Version 1.4 Released!
notes.notes:
Fixed menu music not respecting music volume
Fixed Cavarium utility part showing up as one of the 3 options instead of Cavarium Kit
Changed Remastered Lumite scatter, Auto turret and Zenith Beam fire sounds

notes.title: Version 1.3 Released!
notes.notes:
Fixed item indicator markers bugging out at some distance
Fixed dashing monsters getting stuck

notes.title: Version 1.2 Released!
notes.notes:
Fixed weapon mounting incorrectly when auto pilot is enabled
Fixed Highscore upload exception not kicking in at times
Fixed some elite monster animation not playing
Fixed Concrete Dawn corner pipes not having correct collision
Fixed some monsters with incorrect scaling
Fixed high tier monster death animation looping
Fixed Cavarium achievement not unlocking

notes.title: Version 1,1 Released
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 with some hot fixes.

Added Auto aim (Auto Pilot) which can be toggled. Please note that some mechs do not have this feature (Milena, Praetorian, and RunnerRX)
Fixed Upgrade panel getting stuck if ESC key is pressed just as it opens
Fixed St. Johannes passive not kicking in
Fixed Evolution UI text size fitting
Fixed UI exception happening in some rare cases
Fixed Player Mech Health and Plating not showing up during upgrade
